description: DataSaudi exposes a structured catalogue of official economic and social indicators, including electricity consumption, petroleum production and renewable-project attributes. Entries identify metrics, dimensions and the original statistical agency. The provider is Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning; original agencies listed per table. Coverage: Coverage is Saudi Arabia and its regions. Many energy series are annual; the renewable-project entry references 2025, while time spans differ across tables. Access: The public database explorer displays table definitions and original sources. Neither exports nor an API were exercised. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Some displayed units require checking against original statistical definitions. This catalogue view does not establish a common licence, full history or machine-readable export. For simulation it supplies official energy-demand, production and investment assumptions with source pointers. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this DataSaudi energy-indicator collection.
